# The platform-specific paths. A pull request into `integration` waits for a macOS runner only when its diff touches one of
# these (glob patterns, `*` also crosses a `/`; one per line; `# group: <name>` opens a group). This is the ONE list: the
# `plan` job of .github/workflows/test.yml and the workflow test both read this file and nothing copies it.
# `bin/fleet-switchboard` is left out on purpose: almost every change touches it, and the push to main and the nightly catch a
# platform regression there.

# group: shims
shims/**

# group: plugins
plugins/**

# group: install-and-service
bin/fleet-doctor
bin/fleet-heartbeat
bin/heartbeat-ack
INSTALL.md
templates/**
# the installer runs launchctl print, bootstrap and bootout
bin/switchboard/installer.py

# group: heavy-slot
bin/heavy_slots.py
bin/cpu_guard.py
bin/disk_janitor.py
# github_census picks the /proc reader or the ps/lsof reader by sys.platform
bin/github_census.py
# guard_alert has a sys.platform branch and calls osascript and notify-send
bin/guard_alert.py
# spotlight_guard builds an mdfind command and branches on sys.platform
bin/spotlight_guard.py

# group: workflow
.github/workflows/**
.github/macos-platform-paths.txt
